scope: All ordinary body-flow citations, their smallest nearby claims, all bibliography records, and every publication source file were checked. The literature comparison remains explicitly bounded and makes no priority guarantee.
citation_audit_method: Two-stage non-interactive audit: first freeze manuscript claim/citation pairs and exact line locations; then verify each pair against the authoritative primary-source full text and official publication metadata, followed by BibTeX, body-key, AUX, build-log, and bibliography-coverage checks.
